A '''greenbeak''' was a type of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] animal found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]]. Greenbeaks made a quacking noise and at [[Time/Legends|times]] swam in bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="TOR" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with Koor's visit to [[Vulta]], occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] went to [[Karson's Park]] on Vulta to deliver a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hoverchair]] to his crippled daughter, [[Arra Yooms]]. While he was in the park, there were some greenbeaks swimming in the pond, and Yooms was feeding them with food that she had bought from a [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droid]] that was cleaning the park. Once she received her chair, she proceeded to chase the creatures around the park.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Greenbeaks first appeared in the novel [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="TOR" />
